title: Cambridge IELTS 20 Academic Listening Test 3 Part 1
description: Hội thoại đăng ký dịch vụ và câu lạc bộ chuẩn đề thi Cambridge IELTS 20 Test 3 Part 1.

lines.speaker: Speaker 1 (1)
lines.text: Test three.

lines.speaker: Speaker 1 (2)
lines.text: This is the IELTS listening test.

lines.speaker: Speaker 1 (3)
lines.text: You will hear a number of different recordings, and you will have to answer questions on what you hear.

lines.speaker: Speaker 1 (4)
lines.text: There will be time for you to read the instructions and questions, and you will have a chance to check your work.

lines.speaker: Speaker 1 (5)
lines.text: All the recordings will be played once only.

lines.speaker: Speaker 1 (6)
lines.text: The test is in four parts.

lines.speaker: Speaker 1 (7)
lines.text: At the end of the test, you will be given ten minutes to transfer your answers to an answer sheet.

lines.speaker: Speaker 1 (8)
lines.text: Now turn to part one.

lines.speaker: Speaker 1 (9)
lines.text: Part one.

lines.speaker: Speaker 1 (10)
lines.text: You will hear a woman phoning the owner of a house she is going to rent about companies that she could rent furniture from.

lines.speaker: Speaker 1 (11)
lines.text: First, you have some time to look at questions one to five.

lines.speaker: Speaker 1 (12)
lines.text: Now listen carefully and answer questions one to five.

lines.speaker: Speaker 2 (13)
lines.text: Good morning.

lines.speaker: Speaker 3 (14)
lines.text: Hi.

lines.speaker: Speaker 3 (15)
lines.text: This is Shelley Meyer.

lines.speaker: Speaker 3 (16)
lines.text: I'm renting your house on Archwood Avenue.

lines.speaker: Speaker 3 (17)
lines.text: I'm due to move in next week.

lines.speaker: Speaker 2 (18)
lines.text: Oh, yes.

lines.speaker: Speaker 2 (19)
lines.text: Hello, miss Meyer.

lines.speaker: Speaker 2 (20)
lines.text: What can I do for you?

lines.speaker: Speaker 3 (21)
lines.text: When I viewed the house, I told you I'll most probably need to rent some furniture, at least until I know whether my temporary work contract is going to be made permanent.

lines.speaker: Speaker 2 (22)
lines.text: Yes, of course, I remember, and I said I could give you some information about furniture rental companies in the city.

lines.speaker: Speaker 3 (23)
lines.text: That's right.

lines.speaker: Speaker 2 (24)
lines.text: Well, the biggest company is called Peak Rentals.

lines.speaker: Speaker 2 (25)
lines.text: I've recommended them to other people and have always heard positive reports about them.

lines.speaker: Speaker 3 (26)
lines.text: Could you give me an idea of their costs?

lines.speaker: Speaker 2 (27)
lines.text: Sure.

lines.speaker: Speaker 2 (28)
lines.text: I actually have one of their brochures here.

lines.speaker: Speaker 2 (29)
lines.text: It says the monthly price per room starts at $105 and goes up to $239 That depends on which rooms you need furniture for, of course.

lines.speaker: Speaker 3 (30)
lines.text: Sure.

lines.speaker: Speaker 3 (31)
lines.text: It's just to get a general idea of how much it's going to cost.

lines.speaker: Speaker 3 (32)
lines.text: And you said you had some positive feedback about this company?

lines.speaker: Speaker 2 (33)
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: Speaker 2 (34)
lines.text: People have mentioned that the furniture from Peak Rentals is more modern than any of the other companies.

lines.speaker: Speaker 2 (35)
lines.text: And also, once you place an order, the furniture will be delivered to you in just one or two days.

lines.speaker: Speaker 3 (36)
lines.text: That would be really helpful.

lines.speaker: Speaker 2 (37)
lines.text: Oh, and the brochure says that there's a special offer at the moment.

lines.speaker: Speaker 2 (38)
lines.text: If you rent living room furniture, I believe that's a set of chairs and a TV table, you'll also get a lamp at no extra cost.

lines.speaker: Speaker 3 (39)
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: Speaker 3 (40)
lines.text: But, you know, that price range you gave is more than I was hoping to pay.

lines.speaker: Speaker 2 (41)
lines.text: Then you could try Aaron and Oliver.

lines.speaker: Speaker 3 (42)
lines.text: Sorry.

lines.speaker: Speaker 3 (43)
lines.text: What and Oliver?

lines.speaker: Speaker 2 (44)
lines.text: Aaron, a a r o n.

lines.speaker: Speaker 3 (45)
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: Speaker 3 (46)
lines.text: Are they cheaper?

lines.speaker: Speaker 2 (47)
lines.text: I'd say they're a mid price company, but if you chose them, you need to be aware that they charge an extra 12% every month in case of damage.

lines.speaker: Speaker 3 (48)
lines.text: Oh, I see.

lines.speaker: Speaker 3 (49)
lines.text: I'd have to do the math carefully then.

lines.speaker: Speaker 2 (50)
lines.text: Right.

lines.speaker: Speaker 2 (51)
lines.text: But one helpful thing is that they also do cleaning for customers.

lines.speaker: Speaker 3 (52)
lines.text: For the furniture?

lines.speaker: Speaker 2 (53)
lines.text: For the house.

lines.speaker: Speaker 3 (54)
lines.text: Oh, I see.

lines.speaker: Speaker 3 (55)
lines.text: I probably won't need that.

lines.speaker: Speaker 1 (56)
lines.text: Before you hear the rest of the conversation, you have some time to look at questions six to 10.

lines.speaker: Speaker 1 (57)
lines.text: Now listen and answer questions six to 10.

lines.speaker: Speaker 2 (58)
lines.text: There's another company called Larch Furniture.

lines.speaker: Speaker 2 (59)
lines.text: It's quite new, and it has the lowest prices in town.

lines.speaker: Speaker 2 (60)
lines.text: That's for both furniture and also electronic equipment.

lines.speaker: Speaker 3 (61)
lines.text: Well, that would be good.

lines.speaker: Speaker 3 (62)
lines.text: I'm not bringing much with me and I won't have much time to go shopping after I start my job.

lines.speaker: Speaker 2 (63)
lines.text: There are two things you need to know about large furniture.

lines.speaker: Speaker 2 (64)
lines.text: First of all, you have to take out insurance on the furniture, and you need to organize that yourself.

lines.speaker: Speaker 3 (65)
lines.text: That wouldn't be too hard.

lines.speaker: Speaker 2 (66)
lines.text: Also, you can't take out a contract for less than six months, but I figure that might not be a problem for you.

lines.speaker: Speaker 2 (67)
lines.text: You're renting the house for twelve months after all, aren't you?

lines.speaker: Speaker 2 (68)
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: Speaker 2 (69)
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: Speaker 2 (70)
lines.text: Well Sorry to interrupt.

lines.speaker: Speaker 2 (71)
lines.text: I just thought of another furniture rental company.

lines.speaker: Speaker 2 (72)
lines.text: It's called Space Rentals, and it's located very near to the house.

lines.speaker: Speaker 3 (73)
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: Speaker 2 (74)
lines.text: I don't have any information about their charges, so it's best to use their app to find out what it would cost you to use them.

lines.speaker: Speaker 3 (75)
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: Speaker 3 (76)
lines.text: Thanks.

lines.speaker: Speaker 3 (77)
lines.text: I'll do that.

lines.speaker: Speaker 2 (78)
lines.text: One good thing about that company is that if you don't like the furniture once it's delivered, you can request exchanges as long as you do that within a week of receiving it.

lines.speaker: Speaker 3 (79)
lines.text: That sounds really great.

lines.speaker: Speaker 3 (80)
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: Speaker 3 (81)
lines.text: Well, thanks very much.

lines.speaker: Speaker 3 (82)
lines.text: That's so helpful.

lines.speaker: Speaker 1 (83)
lines.text: That is the end of part one.

lines.speaker: Speaker 1 (84)
lines.text: You now have one minute to check your answers to part one.
